n_even.description: The even integer whose Goldbach partitions are computed

partition_count.description: Number of unordered pairs (p,q) of primes with p+q=n; if zero, Goldbach FALSIFIED for this n (NEVER OBSERVED up to 4e18 per Oliveira e Silva 2014)

partition_pairs_sample.description: First few partition pairs (p, q) for human verification; truncated at 10

partition_graph_eigs.description: Class L: sorted ascending Laplacian eigenvalues of the partition graph G_n (vertices=primes<=n, edges=partition pairs)

fiedler_value.description: Class L: second-smallest Laplacian eigenvalue (algebraic connectivity); = 0 iff G_n disconnected

hardy_littlewood_predicted.description: Hardy-Littlewood 1923 asymptotic prediction r(n) ~ 2 C2 n/(ln n)^2 * Pi correction for primes p|n

density_ratio_observed_predicted.description: Ratio partition_count / hardy_littlewood_predicted; should approach 1 asymptotically

class_cascade.description: Ordered primitive class composition used; e.g. A-compose-J-compose-I-compose-L-compose-M

computation_hash.description: Class A: SHA-256 over (n_even, sorted_partition_pairs) — content-address for provenance
